intro: The Stresses of Iron is a scholarly metallurgical text authored by Margulf Blaggon. Originally kept in the Royal Library of Stormwind Keep, it became the focus of an errand between monks after being loaned out to Northshire Abbey for transcribing.

p: Written by Margulf Blaggon, The Stresses of Iron covers the practical and theoretical properties of metallurgy. Kept within the Royal Library in Stormwind Keep under the care of Milton Sheaf, the book was loaned to Northshire Abbey so that Brother Paxton could copy its contents by hand for his own collection. Paxton's transcription took far longer than anticipated, leaving Brother Kristoff in Cathedral Square waiting anxiously for the text to return to the city.
